arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.date >= '2019-01-01' AND t.date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Computes the labelled fraud rate for each month from January to October 2019, along with the number of labelled transactions behind each rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Months are calendar months of 2019 (January through October), based on transaction date.
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so all ten months are included.
